verdict.reasons: The image correctly displays the target white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll as the sole product. The branding, including the 'AFP' text, 'Drip Irrigation Tape' caption, and the Persian script 'آبگسترفراپارسیان' under the water drop, is authentic and integrated with the 3D form of the cylinder. The scene context is highly relevant, showing the tape installed in a row of wheat crops with visible localized wetting around the plant roots. The required 'AFP | 09134922013' watermark is present and correctly formatted. No core defects such as people, wrong product families, or collage layouts are observed. Minor visual imperfections are advisory only.

focused_physical_review.reason: The continuous black lateral irrigation line emerges from directly behind the base of the white-and-blue AFP package and crosses the same axis, indicating a clear physical contact or overlap. The continuous line prevents the visibility of a broad, uninterrupted soil gap around the complete footprint of the package. No distinct additional loose coils are present outside the primary required package, and no protruding ribbon, strap, or tape tails are visible on the package's exterior surfaces.
